title: yoke help
location: yoke help = yoke --help; group detail: yoke <group> --help
note: The full-catalog route needs a concrete design; no new flag is assumed here. “yoke help TOPIC” currently returns root help. yoke machines --help exposes pending, approve and deny for waiting machines; yoke machine --help manages registered machines.
current: Observed 2026-10-12: yoke --help prints 1,859 lines / 102,636 characters. Cascade repair is not shipped here.
desired: Overview → immediate categories → command recipes. Hard 350 lines; smaller budgets are advisory.
text: yoke tokens --help lists create, list and revoke. Create requires --name LABEL and shows your token once; list reveals metadata only. Lost it? Revoke its ID and create a new one. These operations need no project or harness session. yoke invite PERSON follows the server sign-in method. yoke invites lists code-N and email-N refs, revokes either kind, and reissues codes for the same person. Copy each code once and send it privately.
